why: Proposal A covers every piece the client named in black and dark wood, and it matches the dark floor. The only weak spot is the lounge chair, whose tan leather and bentwood frame are a slightly warm departure from the black-and-gray palette. Proposal B has a lighter walnut desk with hairpin legs, a bookcase only 8 cm deep that is not a low piece, and a reception armchair that is not a small reading chair. Its pieces also look mismatched together.
